svg.title: Issue sessions receive readable task labels with stable short UUIDs
svg.desc: Persist issue + task label (Logic) (added): Issue number, title and current task travel with the assignment.; Start or resume the session (Logic) (context): Checkpoint its actual UUID before submitting work.; Readable title + short UUID (Logic) (added): Bound and sanitize the label; append the first eight session-ID characters.; Codex app server (External service) (context): Owns the session title and executes scoped turns.; Recheck authority before work (Decision) (changed): Rename rejection retains a warning. Revoked authority prevents turn dispatch.; label to session: (flow; conceptual); session to name: (flow; conceptual); name to codex: added: thread/name/set (flow; conceptual); codex to gate: Rename accepted or rejected (flow; conceptual); gate to codex: Authorized: turn/start (branch; conceptual)
